Definition: from G4160; a performer; specially, a "poet"; --doer, poet.
BiblicalUsage: Poietes is a doer, a performer — and, once, a poet. James says to be doers of the word and not hearers only in James 1:22, and warns that the hearer who does not do is like a man looking in a mirror and forgetting his face in James 1:23. Paul says the doers of the law shall be justified in Romans 2:13, and quotes the poets in Acts 17:28: for we are also His offspring.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts doers, not hearers — and even a pagan poet can speak a true word when it agrees with Him. My position is that the mirror only helps the man who acts on what he sees.
